selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Which attribute makes Allah known by revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: What is each work compared to in the passage?
questions.answer: A word with a visible form.

questions.question: Which attribute is shown through things that are wise, orderly, and balanced?
questions.answer: Knowledge.

questions.question: Which attribute is proved by its own signs and also by signs of the other attributes?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: What do living things reflect like mirrors?
questions.answer: Many proofs of Allah’s attributes.

questions.question: Why does the passage say the universe keeps changing?
questions.answer: To show fresh and different displays and designs.

questions.question: Which other attributes also make the Most Sacred Essence known?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: Why is knowledge a sign of life in the passage?
questions.answer: Because knowing belongs to one who lives.

questions.question: Why is Life called the foundation and source of the attributes?
questions.answer: Because many other attributes point to it and depend on it.

questions.question: What place does Life have among the attributes?
questions.answer: It is the base and source of them.

questions.question: What attribute lets people know Allah through messages given from Him?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: In the passage, what are created effects like?
questions.answer: They are like meaningful words you can see.

questions.question: Who is made known by this “book” of the cosmos?
questions.answer: Allah, the Powerful One full of glory.

questions.question: What special qualities in creation point to Knowledge?
questions.answer: Wisdom, order, balance, direction, beauty, and distinctness.

questions.question: What kind of beings stand as witnesses for Life?
questions.answer: All living beings.

questions.question: What does the attribute of Life do to the cosmos all the time?
questions.answer: It keeps changing it.

questions.question: What do Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking do?
questions.answer: They reveal the Most Sacred Essence too.

questions.question: Which attribute can happen only with life: Will or shape?
questions.answer: Will.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect speech with both knowledge and life?
questions.answer: Because speaking belongs to one who knows and lives.

questions.question: Why is purposeful power a sign of life?
questions.answer: Because acting with purpose belongs to living beings.

questions.question: Which attribute makes the Most Sacred Essence known through revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: The attribute of Speech.

questions.question: What does the passage compare these works to?
questions.answer: To outward words.

questions.question: What can a person learn from this great book?
questions.answer: That its Maker is powerful and full of majesty.

questions.question: What are some signs in creation that point to Knowledge?
questions.answer: Careful order, balance, guidance, beauty, and special features.
